title.narrative: The Dominican Specialized Surgical Diagnostic Voluntary Project

description.narrative: - Getting acquainted with the current situation in health facilities in the Dominican Republic to implement volunteer medical projects in the medical field targeting the most needy groups.

Identifying hospitals in Dominican Republic in order to determine on the ground the possibility of implementing volunteer projects, and to know the need in terms of medical specialties, consumables, and medical equipment necessary to implement volunteer projects.

Sending a field medical team to evaluate several hospitals in the Dominican Republic in order to determine on the ground the possibility of implementing volunteer projects, and to know the need in terms of medical specialties, consumables, and medical equipment necessary to implement volunteer projects.
